why: Copernicus GLO-30 here is a DSM captured with the reservoir full: the DEM at the dam is a flat 192.50 m water plane against a published 206.0 m crest, 740.23 km2 of the domain lies below that crest, and the valley is 25.1 km wide there. The impoundment cannot be emplaced or confined, so it is not drained through a breach here -- the released water is prescribed and routed.
